text:
All tests now pass (16 tests). Fixes in `catalog/`:

- `search.py`: imported `normalize` from `catalog.text` instead of the nonexistent module.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to `int`.
- `fees.py`: the fee is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`; it was `+`.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` now returns the last `n` events; it was returning `n + 1`.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the policy comment and the tests.
- `factory.py`: added the missing `Emma` sample book.
